correctness.rationale: The source equation and cone singular-locus calculation reduce the search to the coordinate-axis points plus the two nontrivial weighted orbifold strata. The Q2 and Q3 stack germs are smooth with residual tangent weights giving A_1 and A_2. At P_x, the A_1 cover with the residual involution lifts to an order-four action of type \(\frac14(1,3)\). Independent exact replay confirms \(21/8=[3,3,3]^-\), canonical index seven, and discrepancy vector \((-4/7,-5/7,-4/7)\).
